Preconditions: App is running and user is on the User Details page
Steps: 1. Leave the 'Full Name' field empty | 2. Enter a valid phone number | 3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: An error message ""Please enter your name."" is displayed and no record is written to data/user_details.csv

Title: User submits the form with an invalid phone number
Preconditions: App is running and user is on the User Details page
Steps: 1. Enter a valid full name | 2. Enter a phone number containing letters or too few digits | 3. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: An error message ""Please enter a valid phone number."" is displayed and no record is written to data/user_details.csv
